name: Plaid Developer Tools
description: Enables developers to build agents that fetch Plaid Link conversion insights, usage metrics, and Item diagnostics using the Anthropic API.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Plaid Developer Tools to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Plaid Developer Tools to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.dashboard.plaid.com/mcp/sse. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Plaid Developer Tools MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Plaid Developer Tools provides these MCP tools: plaid_debug_item, plaid_get_link_analytics, plaid_get_usages, and plaid_list_teams.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Plaid Developer Tools?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Plaid Developer Tools in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.

_published_faq.name: Does Plaid Developer Tools MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Plaid Developer Tools requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Plaid Developer Tools is developed by Plaid. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
